```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
picks <- DBI::dbReadTable(con, "picks")
roster <- DBI::dbReadTable(con, "roster")
coaches <- DBI::dbReadTable(con, "coaches")
# Last-school rule, 2014 classes on; a draftee counts once per coach.
window_label <- "2014 classes on"
pairs <- coach_draftee_links(picks, roster, coaches, "last", 2014L) |>
  distinct(year, overall, coach_id, coach_name)
curve <- pairs |>
  count(coach_id, coach_name, name = "draftees", sort = TRUE) |>
  mutate(
    rank = row_number(),
    cum_share = cumsum(draftees) / sum(draftees),
    top = rank <= 10
  )
top10_share <- curve$cum_share[curve$rank == 10]
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
p <- ggplot(curve, aes(rank, 100 * cum_share)) +
  geom_line(colour = "#9CA3AF", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(
      colour = top,
      tooltip = sprintf(
        "#%d %s: %d draftees; the top %d coaches hold %.0f%% of all pairs",
        rank, coach_name, draftees, rank, 100 * cum_share
      ),
      data_id = coach_id
    ),
    size = 2.4
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#374151", `FALSE` = "#9CA3AF"), guide = "none") +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 12,
    y = 100 * top10_share - 10,
    label = sprintf("Top ten: %.0f%%", 100 * top10_share),
    hjust = 0,
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 5.5
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", x), limits = c(0, 100)) +
  labs(
    title = "How much of recent draft output do the top head coaches account for?",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Recent means the ",
      window_label,
      "; cumulative share of draftee-coach pairs, coaches ranked by count"
    ),
    x = "Coach rank (1 is the most draftees)",
    y = "Cumulative share",
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "coaches-share-of-draftees", release = release)
card_interactive(p)
```

```{r}
#| label: by-coach
top12 <- slice_head(curve, n = 12) |>
  mutate(coach_name = reorder(coach_name, draftees))
p_top <- ggplot(top12, aes(draftees, coach_name)) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(
      tooltip = sprintf("%s: %d draftees", coach_name, draftees),
      data_id = coach_id
    ),
    fill = "#374151",
    width = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_text(aes(label = draftees), hjust = -0.2, size = 4.4) +
  expand_limits(x = max(top12$draftees) * 1.15) +
  labs(
    title = "Which head coaches have the most draftees?",
    subtitle = "The twelve coaches with the most draftee-coach pairs",
    x = "Draftee-coach pairs",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "A coach's total spans schools, so the count describes the coach, not one school."
  ) +
  theme_card()
card_interactive(p_top, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 7)
```
